payload.name: Herding behavior in fast fashion purchasing
payload.fact: Herding, anchoring, and framing are strongly related to consumer choices when buying fast fashion products, with anchoring having the strongest effect.

provenance.title: The buying of fast fashion product: Factors affecting consumer behavior
provenance.quote_or_locus: Our findings indicate that all three factors are strongly related to consumer choices regarding the fast fashion products, with anchoring having the strongest effect
